It also provides nylon filament yarns, such as mono filament, mother, multifilament, and tow yarns for use in the apparel industry.

CESC.NS.d: CESC Limited, an integrated electrical utility company, engages in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity to approximately 3.3 million domestic, industrial, and commercial users in the area of 567 square kilometers of Kolkata, Howrah, Hooghly, and North and South 24 Parganas in West Bengal in India.

COMPINFO.NS.d: Compuage Infocom Limited, an information technology (IT) and mobility distribution company, trades in computer parts and peripherals, and software and telecom products in India and internationally. The company also provides products support services for IT products. Compuage Infocom Limited was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

COMPUSOFT.NS.d: Compucom Software Limited operates as a software and education company in India and the United States. It operates through Software Development, Wind Power Generation, and Learning Solutions segments. The company offers IT services, such as enterprise application development, customer relationship management, business process management, supply chain management, and customized learning solutions; as well as grievance redressal systems and mobile solutions.

ELLEN.NS.d: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases Limited was founded in 1973 and has its base in Kolkata, India. It manufactures and distributes industrial gases for Indian and international clients, with segments for gas sales and project engineering services. Its catalog includes oxygen, nitrogen, argon, helium, hydrogen and carbon dioxide.

ESABINDIA.NS.d: ESAB India Limited manufactures and sells welding and cutting equipment in India. The company offers gas equipment; arc gouging and exothermic cutting; welding automation and robotics; ESAB digital solutions; filler metals; arc welding equipment; plasma cutting equipment; and cutting automation products, as well as PPE products and accessories, including helmets and head protection, gloves, clothes, and eye protection products.

EUROMULTI.NS.d: Euro Multivision Limited manufactures and sells optical discs and solar photovoltaic cells in India. The company offers compact disc and digital versatile disc recordable products for various applications, including data storage, recording, and reproduction of audio and video media for entertainment, education, software installation, etc.

GINNIFILA.NS.d: Ginni Filaments Limited manufactures and sells cotton yarns, knitted fabrics, non-woven fabrics, garments, wipes, and cosmetics in India. The company operates through Textiles and Others segments. It offers ring spun, open end, and specialty yarns; single and double jersey, and flat knit fabrics; and garments, such as polo's, round necks, rugby's, henley's, sweat shirts, and leggings for men, ladies, and children.

GLASSWALL.NS.d: Glass Wall Systems (India) Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker GLASSWALL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

HFCL.NS.d: HFCL Limited manufactures and sells telecom products in India and internationally. It offers a range of optical fiber cables for telecommunication, NLD, access, and FTT-x networks, as well as addresses applications through offerings, such as fire survival cables, tactical cables, etc.

HILTON.NS.d: Hilton Metal Forging Limited manufactures and sells iron and steel forgings for oil and gas, refinery, and pharmaceutical industries in India. The company offers stainless steel, high pressure, threaded, blind, weld neck, and socket welded flanges; and forged and hydraulic fittings.

IGRID-RE-ID.NS.d: India Grid Trust is an infrastructure investment trust (InvIT) that owns, operates, and maintains power transmission assets in India. The trust invests in a portfolio of operational transmission lines and substations, providing stable returns to investors. The company is based in Mumbai, India.

LAXMICOT.NS.d: Laxmi Cotspin Limited, founded in 2005 and headquartered in Jalna, India, processes and sells textile products. Its portfolio includes cotton yarns, bales, seeds, oil, fabrics and oil cakes, and it exports to several Asian and European countries.

MADHUCON.NS.d: Madhucon Projects Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated construction, infrastructure development, and management company in India. It operates through Construction, Power, and Toll Collection segments. The company develops and executes engineering, procurement, and construction, as well as turnkey projects.

MANIKA.NS.d: Manika Plastech Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker MANIKA and traded in INR. Its country is India.

MARKOLINES.NS.d: Markolines Pavement Technologies Ltd., established in 2002 and headquartered in Navi Mumbai, provides highway operations and maintenance across India through Highway Maintenance Services and Specialized Construction Services divisions. Formerly Markolines Traffic Controls Limited, it was renamed in October 2021. Its maintenance work includes consultancy and bituminous pavement repair such as milling, overlaying and rehabilitation.

MCL.NS.d: Madhav Copper Limited manufactures and sells copper products in India. The company offers copper fabricated products, enameled copper wires, paper covered copper conductors, poly wrap submersible winding wires, fiberglass copper conductors, tapped insulated copper conductors, and bare copper wires, as well as copper bus bars, strips, rods, and profiles.

MGL.NS.d: Mahanagar Gas Limited operates as a natural gas distribution company primarily in India. The company offers domestic piped natural gas (PNG), commercial PNG, industrial PNG, and compressed natural gas (CNG), as well as manufactures gas geysers.

MOHOTAIND.NS.d: Mohota Industries Limited manufactures and sells yarn and fabrics primarily in India. The company offers various synthetic/cotton/polycotton ring spun yarns; and cotton, single and double dyed, cross dyed, and grey/RFD, as well as plain, twill, and satin bleached and dyed fabrics. It also exports its products to Europe, South America, the Middle East, and the Far East countries. The company was formerly known as The Rai Saheb Rekhchand Mohota Spinning & Weaving Mills Ltd.

MUTHOOTFIN.NS.d: Muthoot Finance Limited operates as a gold financing company in India. It provides personal and business loans secured by gold jewelry, or gold loans primarily to individuals; micro finance; and loans to landlords. The company also offers gold coins, money transfer, foreign exchange, insurance, ATM, wealth succession, and housing finance services; mutual funds and non-convertible debentures; and wealth management services, including risk evaluation, client evaluation, value analysis, and consultancy.

NELCO.NS.d: Nelco Limited provides systems and solutions in the areas of very small aperture terminals (VSAT) connectivity, and integrated security and surveillance. It offers VSAT satellite communication services for renewable energy, enterprise, oil, energy, and gas sectors, as well as to bank ATM and branches.

NIRAJISPAT.NS.d: Niraj Ispat Industries Ltd. produces polyester buttons, typically with two or four thread holes, used in dresses, sweaters, pouches and shirts. The company was founded on 19 August 1985 and is headquartered in Ghaziabad, India.

NSLNISP.NS.d: NMDC Steel Limited makes and sells steel products in India, including hot rolled coils, sheets, plates for welded pipe, structural and silicon steel, pig iron and grades for LPG cylinders, boilers and pressure vessels. It serves infrastructure, automotive, energy and engineering industries. Incorporated in 2015, it is based in Hyderabad.

PAKKA.NS.d: Pakka Limited, established in 1981 and based in Ayodhya, was known as Yash Pakka Limited until July 2023. It makes and sells paper-based and molded products in India and for export, in two divisions: Paper, Pulp, and Other Products, and Moulded Products. Its range includes CHUK-brand molded food service items, agricultural pulp, kraft papers and flexible packaging.

PALASHSECU.NS.d: Palash Securities Limited, an investment company, engages in food processing business in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Food Processing Business and Investing Business. The company offers canned fruits and vegetables, jams jellies, marmalades, juices, tomato ketchups/purees/sauces, vegetable sauces, and squashes, as well as breakfast cereals, such as cornflakes, chocos, white oats, etc. It also invests and deals in shares and securities; and immovable properties.

RHFL.NS.d: Reliance Home Finance Limited engages in the housing finance business in India. The company offers a range of loans, such as home loans, affordable housing loans, loans against properties, and construction finance. It also provides property services. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Mumbai, India.

SAKSOFT.NS.d: Saksoft Limited, an information technology company, provides digital transformation solutions in Europe, the United States, the Asia Pacific, and internationally. The company offers application services in the areas of custom application development, Internet of Things, mobile application development, cloud, and block chain.

SANGAMIND.NS.d: Sangam (India) Limited manufactures and sells PV dyed yarns in India and internationally. Its product portfolio includes PV blended dyed/grey yarns, cotton spun and open ended yarns, indigo rope dyed yarns, texturized yarns, PV fabrics and processed fabrics, synthetic blended fabrics, cotton knitted fabrics, and denim fabrics, as well as seamless garments, such as air wear, intimate wear, shape wear, leisure wear, active wear, and casual wear garments for women.

SONAMLTD.NS.d: Sonam Limited, an Indian company founded in 1996 and headquartered in Morbi, makes and sells timekeeping products and their components. Its catalogue includes alarm timepieces and many styles of clocks, ranging from basic dial and office models to more decorative designs.

STEELXIND.NS.d: Steel Exchange India Limited manufactures and sells steel and related products in India. It produces ingots using sponge iron and scrap/pig iron; TMT bars; sponge iron products, including lumps, fines, and briquettes; and steel billets. The company also trades in various products ranging from finished steel products to semis, coal, scrap, sponge iron, etc. It sells TMT bars under the Simhadri TMT Bars brand. In addition, the company generates power from waste heat.

SWIGGY.NS.d: Swiggy Limited runs the Swiggy platform, through which customers in India browse, order and pay for food delivery. Its segments include food delivery, quick commerce, out-of-home consumption, supply chain and distribution, and platform innovation. Related services include grocery delivery through Instamart, restaurant reservations through Dineout, event bookings, pick-up and drop-off, and hyperlocal commerce.

TREEHOUSE.NS.d: Tree House Education & Accessories Limited, an educational services provider, operates pre-schools in India. The company offers a range of programs for children, including play group, nursery, junior kindergarten (KG), senior KG, day care services, teacher training courses, summer camps, and hobby classes. It also franchises its schools, as well as leases education infrastructure to K12 schools. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Mumbai, India.

UNIECOM.NS.d: Unicommerce eSolutions Ltd., established in Gurugram in 2012, provides software-as-a-service tools for e-commerce operations to clients in India and abroad. Its products include a Warehouse Management System for tracking stock locations and quantities, along with inventory-related software.

UNIVPHOTO.NS.d: Universus Photo Imagings Limited manufactures, sells, and trades in photographic and other imaging products. It offers photographic papers, NTR films, medical X-ray films, etc. The company was formerly known as Jindal Photo Imaging Limited and changed its name to Universus Photo Imagings Limited in December 2019. Universus Photo Imagings Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is based in New Delhi, India.

VSTTILLERS.NS.d: V.S.T. Tillers Tractors Limited engages in the manufacture and trading of agriculture machinery primarily in India. The company provides power tillers, tractors, rice transplanters, power reapers, rotary tillers, attachments, and engines.

WPIL.NS.d: WPIL Limited and its subsidiaries design, develop, make, erect, commission and service pumps, together with pumping systems, in India and abroad. Its pumps include dewatering, sewage, drainage, deepwell, non-clog, end suction, multistage, split case, turbine, and mixed and axial flow types, as well as fire fighting packages.

YOGI.NS.d: Yogi Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker YOGI and traded in INR. Its country is India.
